sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/SANKARA HOTEL/Sankara - Sunworld Safaris - Contract Rate 2026.pdf
notes: This is a flexible Nairobi/stopover hotel candidate not yet in CLAUDE.md's known priced list - now part of Marriott's Autograph Collection with access to Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program.
Rate confidentiality clause: agreed rates may not be revealed to or used to book for third parties, nor displayed transparently on the internet.
notesOnRates: Net and non-commissionable. Inclusive of 18% statutory taxes and breakfast at Artisan Restaurant. Room service charged separately.
accommodationEnhancements: Separate Turkish steam/sauna for ladies and gentlemen
Outdoor rooftop infinity pool with sun-lounge

benefits: 2 hours free use of 2 state-of-the-art boardrooms (extra hours charged)

childPolicy.raw: Child in baby cot (up to 4yrs) or up to 12yrs sharing a room with an adult: free. Up to 2 children under 12 in a separate interconnecting room: 75% of room rate.

maxOccupancy.raw: Max 2 adults per room. With children: max 1 child under 4 (1 baby cot) or max 1 child 5-12 sharing bed with adult. No extra bed except in Executive Suites.

policies.dayRoom: 75% of applicable rate, check-out by 18:00 (full rate applies after 18:00)
policies.complimentaryRooms: 1 free room per 15 paying guests in a group (16th guest)
policies.singleRoomPolicy: Single rate applies to max 7 single rooms per group; additional singles charged at double rate
policies.deposit: 50% due if booked 8-14 days prior to arrival; 100% due if booked 0-7 days prior to arrival (separate policy for groups/conferences)
policies.cancellation: 0-7 days: 100% of entire stay; 8-14 days: 50%; 15-35 days: 25%; no-show: 100%
policies.invoiceDispute: Must be raised within 7 days of invoice date
